title: Runescape Dragonwilds: Kuldra Fight Walkthrough
author: Benny and the Chickenboy
description:
Two lifelong friends, Benny and the Chickenboy take on KULDRA, Runescape Dragonwilds' newest endgame boss in the Scorned Wilderness. 

The Scorned Wilderness contains the game's first raid, new weapons and supplies, and the Final Boss of the Kuldra Saga.

If you enjoyed this video, consider liking, subscribing, and leaving a comment telling us what you think of the game!! We really appreciate the support.

Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/ANgd5B7Tbt
Dragonwilds Livestreams:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BGYF4M_PgGg&list=PLwJuV4brGwe2MsnR1TzuVOVbpcbZMDkFC

SOLO FIGHT: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BNrLFCloSfw

All video/picture from Jagex 

#runescape #dragonwilds #survivalgame
